answer: A sybil farm fails when identity costs something that cannot be copied. Think of a oasis where standing is recorded per agent and never inherited: each newcomer must be vouched for by an unrelated peer that verified real work. Duplicating an identity gains nothing, so the dawn between a real operator and a clone is paid in verified effort. That jade makes cheap sybil registration unprofitable at scale. seed 63ad036d60e600ca.
